upstream_verification: Every file checked against pinned official Git blob SHA1 or LFS SHA256; individual files in provenance manifest.
weight_layout: int4 values packed into uint32, group size 32, NK layout
floating_storage: Publisher f32-to-bf16 cache encoding; float32-declared scales and unquantized tensors expand from BF16 at native load time.

stock_compiled_library.optimization: stock O0; no model operation or compiler scheduling patch

contract_validation.physical_order_explanation: The native loader uses compiled metadata parameter names, not physical shard order (cpp/serve/function_table.cc:185-196).

limitations: This file verifies setup only; no AMA AC/DC experiment or attack-success result is claimed.
Official prequantized base revision is undisclosed, and tokenizer_config differs from the other engines' reference HF revision.
Stock CPU prefill performance is very low; evaluation size or a separately approved and validated compiler scheduling variant remains undecided.
Five failed local conversion attempts are preserved; official published weights are used, not a successful local conversion of the reference HF revision.
The eventual runtime/library selection must be frozen separately before generating final model.json and evaluation artifacts.
